summary: First testing iteration for SplitLens bill-splitting app. All backend APIs (3/3) and frontend features tested successfully. Backend health endpoints and receipt scan placeholder working correctly. Frontend loads properly with dark theme, all interactive elements functional, calculations accurate, AsyncStorage persistence working. Minor deprecation warning for TouchableWithoutFeedback component.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: 'TouchableWithoutFeedback is deprecated. Please use Pressable.' Used in BottomSheet component for backdrop and keyboard dismissal.

action_items: Replace TouchableWithoutFeedback with Pressable in index.tsx (lines 261, 661) for future React Native compatibility
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is excellent - proper TypeScript usage, all testIDs present, clean component structure
Backend is intentionally minimal (stateless placeholder) - no MongoDB usage as designed
Receipt scan simulation is working as specified (deterministic based on file size)
All calculations are accurate and update reactively
Dark theme implementation matches design guidelines perfectly
Mobile-first design with proper touch targets (44px minimum)
Error handling present in receipt scan with fallback to local simulation
seed_data_creation: No seed data needed - app is stateless and works offline-first
context_for_next_testing_agent: First iteration complete. All core features working. Only minor deprecation warning for TouchableWithoutFeedback. If main agent updates to Pressable, retest bottom sheet interactions (backdrop tap, keyboard dismissal) to ensure no regressions.

receipt_scan.different_sizes: ✓ Different file sizes produce different totals

frontend_tests.split_type_toggle: ✓ Switches between count and named modes

receipt_scanner.open_sheet: ✓ Scan receipt button opens bottom sheet
receipt_scanner.pick_button: ✓ Pick receipt button present (image picker may not work on web)
